CustomField.description: How a number, currency or percent field displays on the form. Standard is the normal input. Stepper adds minus and plus buttons around it. Slider shows a draggable range with a readout, bounded by the field's Min and Max (0 to 100 for a percent with none set). Preset Amounts shows the quick-pick chips set in Preset Amounts, with a free-entry input. Part of Form Builder's per-type display settings, alongside the text, picklist and lookup display types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Overrides how a numeric field displays on the form. Stepper adds minus and plus buttons, Slider renders a draggable range with a readout, and Preset Amounts offers configured quick-pick values. The field's currency or percent formatting applies in every mode.
CustomField.label: numberType
